levers.waitHint: Launch when the Sun is back
levers.relayHint: A helper in orbit passes our messages on
levers.batteryHint: More power for the long dark

final.title: Mission complete!
learned: Landers need sunlight and a view of Earth.
Hills and craters can hide the Sun.
final.note: Simplified for learning: the batteries and the relay are illustrative.

intro: Hello, explorer. I'm {name}, and we are going to the Moon's south pole, where ice hides in the cold.
Two golden rules keep a lander alive. It needs sunlight for power, and it must see Earth to talk to us.
Choose a lander below. Each one carries a different battery for the long nights.

battery.artemis: A big battery, patient through long nights. Heavy, but brave.
battery.apollo: A steady battery, made for short visits. It likes bright days.
battery.novac: A small battery, light as a feather. Night makes it shiver.
battery.vikram: A tiny battery, quick to sleep. It needs the Sun close by.
battery.polar: A careful battery, built for the pole. It hopes for sunny hilltops.

site.intro: Here the Sun never climbs high. It rolls along the horizon like a slow golden ball.
site.happy: Sun on the panels and Earth in the sky. This spot feels right.
site.worried: Only one of our two rules is true here. Let's look a little longer.
site.sleeping: Dark and quiet. The lander would sleep here, perhaps forever.
site.shadow: This crater floor has not seen the Sun for ages. Try the high ground on a rim.
site.ready: {site} could work. Press Continue when you are sure.
site.darkWeek: Every spot is dark this week. Let's jump to a brighter one.

launch.cheer: Up we go! Hold on tight, the Moon is waiting.

anomaly.delay: Oh no, a storm on Earth held us back. We lifted off some days late.
anomaly.night: The Sun has already left {site}. The night ahead is longer than our battery.
anomaly.earth: From here, Earth hides behind the hills. Our messages cannot get home.
anomaly.contact: Silence. Earth has slipped behind the hills, and our words go unheard.

fix.intro: Every mission has a bump. Pick a lever and watch the verdict change.
fix.move: Higher ground sees the Sun sooner. Let's pack up and move.
fix.wait: Patience is a tool too. We will wait for the Sun to return.
fix.relay: A relay satellite will carry our words. It costs a lot, but it hears us.
fix.battery: A bigger battery for the dark. The lander grows heavier, though.
fix.noWait: No sunny day comes soon enough. Try another lever.
fix.go: Green at last! You turned a bad day into a good plan.
fix.notyet: Not yet. Try another lever, or combine two.

done.cheer: You did it, Space Planner. The Moon remembers brave choices.
